Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010).
Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

We therefore propose to keep EUR 29.89 per piece, the price we have paid since January 2024.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge the increased volume and extended contract term, which permit a price adjustment.
We propose EUR 31.50 per unit under these revised terms.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

We propose EUR 30.40 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.10 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
Please note:
We verified the labour cost index data you cited and incorporated it into our assessment.
The extension to a 36-month contract term permits a further price adjustment.
We propose EUR 31.10 per unit for this commitment.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
